edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. At Closing, the Buyer shall pay the Seller USD 32,000,000 for the Shares by wire transfer of immediately available funds.

3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents that the financial statements provided to the Buyer have been prepared in accordance with GAAP consistently applied by the Company throughout the periods presented, except as disclosed in the notes thereto, and fairly present, in all material respects, the Company's financial position as of their respective dates, subject, in the case of interim statements, to normal year-end adjustments and the absence of footnotes.

4. INDEMNITY. The Seller shall indemnify the Buyer for losses arising from a breach of the Seller's representations or warranties under this Agreement. Claims for breaches of non-fundamental representations must be made within 18 months after Closing and are recoverable only to the extent aggregate covered losses exceed USD 250,000, in which case only the excess is recoverable. The Seller's aggregate liability for such claims shall not exceed 10% of the Purchase Price. These limitations do not apply to fraud or breaches of representations concerning the Seller's title to the Shares or authority to enter into this Agreement.
